messages.content:
Answer a fixed set of questions about the state the user provides. Each question lists its allowed answers; reply with exactly one label per question.

Question move: Select the next move for the snake head. Choose recommended_safe_move in safe_moves that reduces manhattan_to_food while preserving open_space.
  a: up (Move north (y - 1))
  b: down (Move south (y + 1))
  c: left (Move west (x - 1))
  d: right (Move east (x + 1))

Reply with one line per question, in this order, formatted as "id: label".
